summary: Architecture v0.1 with sub-document 04a-traceability (sha256 597988d775eb2f4cf9c56f147ca933efa5072421c82c2ff1612f80fdff73af9a). Records the built PH-1/PH-2 system and the main lease as baseline. Designs the eleven PH-2 rows without tasks (P10 minted hub id + hub signing key; P11 signed revocation list pulled each tick; P13 receiver quotas, adaptive window, hop limit; P15 blobs encrypted to a new per-agent X25519 key, ciphertext in the recipient's home hub store, artifact --hub encrypted only; P16 reconciliation on start; P17 consumer list, admin log, sweep refusal, founding-verb log, key card, signed dead letter; P18 status strength flags, reachability card, CLEAR; P19 six fault injectors; P21 doorbell only for unattended sessions with an SI-1 line; P22 vendor-channel log; P24 W3 acceptance) and R-67.a1(4) forward-once in a FORWARD envelope with VIA notice. Decides the step-4 values V-1..V-15 as starting values (GP-11 open), proposes security levels L0-L2, 14 decision records, 6 change requests, 24 build items.
